DBP.comment: Siadenovirus DBP is spliced: turkey hemorrhagic enteritis virus (THEV, Virginia avirulent strain) CDS starts at 18186 with a 10-residue exon 1, donor 18159, a 72-nt intron, acceptor 18087, giving a 380-aa protein (PMID 39107824, Tables 2 and S3; verified on AY849321: ATG, GT..AG, 380 aa). The previous PSSM called only the exon-2 portion (336-350 aa). Extended to other siadenoviruses by aligning the donor and acceptor regions to the THEV anchor; because exon 1 is too short to align as protein it was located from the acceptor side and, where needed, by searching for the ATG..GT exon 1 that keeps exon 2 in frame and best matches the THEV exon-1 peptide (unique best only). Every distinct product was translated and aligned with the anchor product to confirm exon 2 is in frame. Covers 42 of 69 module genomes; 10 of the misses are partial THEV assemblies (23.8 kb) lacking the region. 17 unique references, products 368-382 aa; min_len = 0.95 x shortest. Jim chose splice over the exon-2 PSSM (13 Nov 2026).

K33.comment: L4-33K is translated from a spliced mRNA whose intron interrupts the protein coding sequence; L4-22K is the unspliced form and shares exon 1 (PMID 25636034). Splice junctions mapped by cDNA in ovine adenovirus (PMID 7778275). Exon A lengths measured here are not multiples of 3, confirming the mid-codon intron. Called from Splice-Variants/K33.fasta, never from a profile.

VI_MAT.comment: HAdV-5 pVI residues 34-239: cut after 33 (MSGG^AF) and 239 (IVGL^GV); removes pVIn and the 11-aa protease cofactor pVIc. Cut sites are the HAdV-2/5 adenovirus protease (AVP) sites from the literature, carried to every precursor in the collection by pairwise alignment to the HAdV-5 protein; a site is accepted only where the member carries the AVP consensus (M/I/L/V)XGX^G or (M/I/L/V)XGG^X (PMID 2691633) at the aligned residue or uniquely within 2 residues. The product is installed in a module only where >=60% of its precursors carry the site. 19/19 precursors of this module cut.
